title: security: rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Maya Patel
description: Implements enforcement and audit improvements for RBAC v2 KMS region pinning. Motivation: customers with strict data residency requirements were able to bypass KMS region constraints via legacy RBAC paths and there was insufficient audit fidelity for cross-region key usage. This PR: 1) Adds enforcement hooks in rbac v2 evaluation pipeline to validate KMS key region against resource residency constraints, 2) Enhances audit logging to include KMS key id, region, resolved principal, and policy match context for every crypto operation, 3) Provides a migration helper and a compatibility mode flag for Dedicated/Private installations to help pin keys by region without breaking existing roles, 4) Adds end-to-end tests and integration test harness updates for region-residency scenarios, 5) Updates docs and CLI helpers for admins to list pinning violations and run remediation. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and feature flags.

release_notes: Enforceable RBAC v2 KMS region pinning and richer audit logs for KMS operations. Admins can opt into enforcement via feature flag; migration tooling and diagnostics included.
notes_for_ops: Operators: rotation plan included. When enabling enforcement, run 'admin pinning audit --preview' to collect existing violations, then run migration script in deploy/compatibility. Monitor 'audit.kms.pin_violation' metric after rollout.
notes_for_security: Audit events now include kms.key_id and kms.region; retention policy recommended at 365 days for compliance-sensitive customers. Ensure SIEM parsers are updated to ingest the new audit fields.
changelog_entry: Security: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning enforcement + audit logging enhancements (feature-flagged).
test_plan: Unit tests added for evaluator and audit redaction; e2e scenarios cover same-region, cross-region, and cross-tenant attempts; CI integration-residency job validates runtime behavior. Manual verification steps included in docs.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: core enforcement adds checks in path for key usage; feature-flagged to avoid immediate customer impact. Backout plan available by toggling feature flag to 'audit' and reverting merge if needed within release window.
compatibility_notes: Dedicated and Private deployments must run the migration script prior to enabling enforcement. The CLI helper provides a preview mode to list affected roles and keys.
